Lumen Lane Studio print archive.

catalog/ holds the current 2026 season; archive/ holds the closed 2024
season under the same file name, print-index.csv. Counts quoted to
clients come from catalog/ only, and the archive is kept for reference.

turns.prompt: I'm onboarding at Lumen Lane Studio and need a tour of the print index folder for my first client call. Summarize what's in there: how many prints the current index lists, how the luster prints break down, and what the copy sitting in the archive folder is.
